detectorSemantics.completeRawScalarScan: Every scalar leaf in all ten inputs is counted; every leaf whose field name matches unitFieldPattern is listed with its pointer and hash.
detectorSemantics.recordUniverse: The current universe is the exact 2,161 historical record IDs from the immutable before inventory plus the one hash-bound Jo unextracted-price record; no other additions or substitutions are admitted. Each current record lists every matching field pointer in its raw object.
detectorSemantics.nullMetadata: Null values are unassessable metadata and never treated as evidence that a printed source omits a quantity or unit.
detectorSemantics.classification: explicit-printed/editorial are used only for the exact source-page reviewed cases below. missing-provenance marks a populated semantic unit field without a dedicated field-level unit provenance disposition; it does not mean the source lacks that unit. The registered Jo purchase price and unit remain unassessed, and the admission is not source-absence proof. All other candidates are unassessable.
detectorSemantics.privacy: The report contains counts, identifiers, JSON pointers, source/input hashes, field names and value hashes. It contains no source text, OCR, PDF or page images.
